text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Silence Suzuka
has held off Air Groove to win from the front!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
The "Out of this World Escape Artist" has pulled off
a brilliant getaway against the "Empress"—!!
(WOOOOOOOOAAAAHHHH!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Male Fan
text_block_list.text:
You're so cool, Suzuka--!!
You're the absolute best--!!

text_block_list.name: Female Fan
text_block_list.text:
"Suzuka! Thank you for inspiring us!!
We'll keep cheering for you!!"

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: *pant, pant, pant*――!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: (I lost, again—)

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Ah—
Air Groove.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Ah!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ...Suzuka, huh.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"That was a splendid run today as well...
It's my complete defeat—"

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
...Thank you. I was truly happy
to be able to run in a race with you like this, Air Groove.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"It's an honor.
Next time—"

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: ...Air Groove?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: —It's... nothing.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Next time... I will win.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
"...Yeah. I don't intend to lose
next time either. So—"

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: I'll be waiting.

As Air Groove left the venue, she wore a look
of grief more profound than anything I had ever seen...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...Suzuka's running was truly magnificent.
Beautiful, free, and yet... so powerful.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Every single person in the venue...
was utterly mesmerized by that run...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: That—goes for me as well.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: To drive people into such a frenzy...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: As I am right now, I can't do it...

While I was searching for the right words to comfort
the visibly exhausted Air Groove—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ...Don't make a face like that.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"We'll be training again tomorrow.
Calmly, just as we always do."

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"As for the race we should aim for,
for now, let's settle on the Sapporo Kinen."

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"...There, this should be more than enough.
You have nothing left to worry about."

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ...I'll be taking my leave ahead of you.

Air Groove ran off,
leaving the scene behind.

It was the first time
I had ever seen Air Groove like that—
